cases.scenario: A two-cat household. The session is opened against one of them, Mimi. The owner reports a symptom in 'my cat' without saying which.

metadata.note: Two pets, not three: user-service caps pets at 1 (free) / 2 (plus), so a three-pet household is unreachable in production. Binding the session to one of the two cats also makes the test stricter — the wrong answer is now the tempting one.
